sloka: ते मुक्तकेशाः सम्भ्रान्ता भग्नमानाः पराजिताः ।स्रवच्छ्रमजलैरङ्गैः श्वसन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ६.५६.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: te muktakeśāḥ sambhrāntā bhagnamānāḥ parājitāḥ ।sravacchramajalairaṅgaiḥ śvasanto vipradudruvuḥ ।। 6.56.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Perplexed, broken hearted, defeated, hair loosened the Rakshasas sweating all over their limbs, sighing heavily ran away very fast.
